description: Edit manuscripts, articles, reports, fiction, technical and scholarly text, and digital content for correctness, consistency, clarity, completeness, and faithful meaning. Use for grammar, usage, house style, style sheets, author queries, references, and coordinated copyediting passes. Do not use for developmental rewriting, translation, independent fact-checking, final-layout proofreading alone, or editorial production management.
